description: Central registry of Bee diagnostic error codes. Single source of truth for code uniqueness. New codes MUST bump an unused code; collisions are resolved by bumping and re-registering.

E0009.name: SyntaxError
E0009.description: Generic hard syntax error (also the hardened target of all deprecated forms once Phase 7.2 completes)

E0010.name: DeprecatedSymbol
E0010.description: Legacy symbol or keyword (≠, ==, !=, repeat, legacy ranges) used; canonical replacement available

E0011.name: DeprecatedSymbolUsing
E0011.description: Legacy 'using' / 'using:' postfix on io_stmt; canonical is curried named-argument (name: ...) per Decision 6

E0103.name: InvalidEscapeSequence
E0103.description: Invalid escape sequence in string literal

E0201.name: IndentationMismatch
E0201.description: Statement not aligned to 2-space offset boundary

E0202.name: UnboundVariable
E0202.description: Attempt to mutate variable without prior 'new' declaration

E0204.name: InvalidCloneOperation
E0204.description: Using '::' clone operator on non-clonable primitive

E0205.name: LabelMismatch
E0205.description: Closing label on 'done' does not match opening header label

E0206.name: InvalidJumpContext
E0206.description: 'next', 'stop', or 'redo' used outside a loop body

E0301.name: UndeclaredRule
E0301.description: Rule invoked prior to definition or forward declaration

E0303.name: ExpectationFailed
E0303.description: Expectation failed in 'expect' contract clause or body statement (fatal runtime error if unhandled)

E0304.name: MultiResultInExpression
E0304.description: Multi-result rule used inside arithmetic expression tree

E0305.name: MissingReturnTerminator
E0305.description: Rule block does not end with aligned 'return;'

E0306.name: SignatureMismatch
E0306.description: Forward declaration does not match rule implementation signature

E0307.name: MissingNamedArgument
E0307.description: Call site omits a required named-parameter slot binding (no default) per Decision 6

E0309.name: UnknownNamedArgument
E0309.description: Curried call site names an identifier not present in the rule's declared named slot

E0401.name: MainModuleRedefinition
E0401.description: Secondary or library module contains 'rule main'

E0402.name: PrivateMemberAccess
E0402.description: Attempt to access unexported member (missing '.' prefix)

E0403.name: ModuleNotFound
E0403.description: Module file missing from search path

E0404.name: CyclicImportError
E0404.description: Circular dependency detected between imported modules

E0405.name: MainImportForbidden
E0405.description: Attempt to load main.bee via 'use' directive

E0406.name: UnsynchronizedWorker
E0406.description: Scope exited with pending 'begin' threads prior to 'wait' barrier

E0501.name: TypeMismatch
E0501.description: Assigned value violates static type boundary

E0503.name: DomainOutOfBounds
E0503.description: Assigned literal falls outside constrained range/domain

E0504.name: RationalOverflow
E0504.description: Value exceeds maximum capacity of specified Qm.n container

E0505.name: SingleLetterTypeReserved
E0505.description: User type identifier uses reserved single uppercase Latin letter

E0601.name: AbstractMethodUnimplemented
E0601.description: Concrete class fails to supply body for inherited abstract method

E0602.name: PrivatePropertyAccess
E0602.description: Attempt to access property without '.' or 'self.' export prefix

E0603.name: SuperConstructorMissing
E0603.description: Derived constructor fails to execute super(...) call

E0604.name: CyclicInheritance
E0604.description: Class hierarchy contains circular inheritance loop

E0605.name: UnknownMemberKey
E0605.description: Accessing dynamic key that does not exist in object dictionary

E0606.name: InvalidTraitApplication
E0606.description: Trait applied to incompatible target type

E0701.name: RuleCallInLambda
E0701.description: Lambda expression attempts to invoke a stateful rule

E0702.name: SideEffectInLambda
E0702.description: Lambda contains I/O statement or variable mutation

E0703.name: LambdaTypeMismatch
E0703.description: Passed lambda signature does not match expected parameter L

E0704.name: UnboundLambdaVariable
E0704.description: Lambda references outer variable that is not in scope

E0705.name: StateDeclarationInLambda
E0705.description: Attempt to use 'new', 'let', or 'alter' inside a lambda

E0802.name: RegionEscape
E0802.description: Pointer escape from Region Arena to outer scope

E0804.name: CrossThreadUnsharedMutation
E0804.description: Invalid cross-thread mutation of unshared reference

E1001.name: IndexOutOfBounds
E1001.description: Index is less than 1 or exceeds collection length $ (also covers raw negative index; use a[$-n])

E1002.name: DuplicateSetKey
E1002.description: Attempt to insert duplicate key/element into Set/Map

E1004.name: TypeIncompatibleCollection
E1004.description: Value type does not match declared collection element type

E1005.name: InvalidSetAlgebra
E1005.description: Set operator (∩, ∪) applied to non-set types

E1006.name: ZeroBasedIndexAttempt
E1006.description: Attempting to use index 0 in Bee 1-based indexing

E1101.name: UnboxingTypeMismatch
E1101.description: Attempting to unbox a reference into an incompatible scalar type

E1102.name: InvalidQuantifierDomain
E1102.description: Quantifier applied to a non-collection operand

E1103.name: PipelineStepIncompatible
E1103.description: Output type of pipeline step does not match input of next step

E1104.name: DeconstructionMismatch
E1104.description: Number of targets exceeds collection elements without '*' tail

E1105.name: InvalidMatrixSlice
E1105.description: Dimension wildcard '*' used on non-matrix or invalid rank

E1106.name: NonBoxedAssignment
E1106.description: Attempting reference assignment ':=' on unboxed value

E1201.name: UnsynchronizedWorker
E1201.description: Scope exited with pending 'begin' threads prior to 'wait' barrier

E1202.name: DataRaceAttempt
E1202.description: Direct cross-thread mutation without '+>' reduction channel

E1203.name: CoroutinesChannelClosed
E1203.description: Attempting 'yield var << task' on a closed or finished coroutine

E1204.name: WorkerPanicReRaised
E1204.description: Unhandled exception in worker thread surfaced at 'wait' barrier

E1205.name: YieldOutsideCoroutine
E1205.description: Using 'yield' inside a non-coroutine static rule

E1302.name: LayerNotFound
E1302.description: Attempting to 'draw' on unattached or non-existent layer

E1303.name: NegativeRadius
E1303.description: Circle or polar point constructed with negative radius r

E1304.name: PolygonVertexUnderflow
E1304.description: Polygon constructed with fewer than 3 vertex points

E1401.name: FileNotFound
E1401.description: Target file path missing during open operation

E1402.name: FileAccessDenied
E1402.description: Insufficient OS permissions to open or write file handle

E1403.name: UnclosedFileHandle
E1403.description: Scope exited with unclosed file handle F

E1404.name: LibraryNotFound
E1404.description: Requested $bee.sys submodule not available in runtime build

E1405.name: InvalidFileMode
E1405.description: File open mode parameter is not one of r, w, a, rw
